description: This file implements a database-backed configuration store for Mattermost, including functions for initializing, loading, saving, and managing configuration data and files, with support for migrations and external dependencies.

classes.name: DatabaseStore
classes.description: A struct that manages database-backed configuration storage, including connection handling, migration setup, and configuration file management.

methods.name: NewDatabaseStore
methods.description: Creates a new DatabaseStore instance, establishing a database connection and initializing configuration tables.

methods.name: initializeConfigurationsTable
methods.description: Ensures migration tables are set up and applies database migrations.

methods.name: parseDSN
methods.description: Parses and validates a PostgreSQL DSN, returning the scheme and DSN.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the current configuration in the database.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes and saves configuration data to the database, avoiding duplicates via checksum comparison.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the active configuration from the database, returning default if none exists.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Retrieves a previously stored configuration file by name.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Stores or updates a configuration file in the database.

methods.name: HasFile
methods.description: Checks if a configuration file exists in the database.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Deletes a configuration file from the database.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a sanitized string representation of the database connection string.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the database connection and cleans up resources.

methods.name: cleanUp
methods.description: Removes old configuration entries from the database based on a timestamp threshold.
